description: This file defines the ArrayType data type used in Spark SQL, including its companion object and case class implementation, with methods for type construction, serialization, and recursive transformations.

classes.name: ArrayType
classes.description: A case class representing an array data type with element type and nullability, including methods for string representation, JSON serialization, size estimation, and recursive transformation.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Constructs an ArrayType with the specified element type, defaulting containsNull to true.

methods.name: defaultSize
methods.description: Estimates default size of the array type based on element type.

methods.name: simpleString
methods.description: Returns a simple string representation of the array type.

methods.name: catalogString
methods.description: Returns a catalog string representation of the array type.

methods.name: sql
methods.description: Returns an SQL string representation of the array type.

methods.name: asNullable
methods.description: Returns a nullable version of the array type.

methods.name: toNullable
methods.description: Public method to get a nullable array type.

methods.name: buildFormattedString
methods.description: Builds a formatted string describing the array type and its element type, used for debugging or documentation.

methods.name: existsRecursively
methods.description: Checks recursively if a condition holds for this data type or its element type.

methods.name: transformRecursively
methods.description: Recursively applies a transformation function to this data type and its element type.
